messages:
Samir Khandekar: Quick async check — I started a thread for onboarding the two new community models (Mosaic-X-1.2 and FalconLite-3B). Need clarity on: owners, licensing signoff, perf profiles (latency/cost targets), and any runtime blockers. @Mira @Josh can you confirm owners by EOD?

Mira Chen: I can own Mosaic-X-1.2 onboarding. Will run the license scan today. ETA 24h.

Josh Patel: I can take FalconLite-3B. Does it need special quantization for T4s? cc @Alex

Alex Gomez: FalconLite looks quant-friendly but we should try q5/bf16 fallback. I can do a quick perf sweep on staging tomorrow morning. Any typical seq-lens we should prioritize?

Zoe Carter: From product POV, start with seq_len=128 and 512 for gen workloads. We care about 95th pct latency under 150ms for hosted, and under 300ms in Dedicated baseline.

Priya Rao: Legal: I started license review for both. Preliminary flag on Mosaic-X due to a mixed license clause—need to confirm upstream dependencies. If we get a positive review, I'll post the approval comment. ETA 36–48h.

Mira Chen: Thanks Priya. I pulled the model weights and ran an initial `pip install` check. No binary-only bits surfaced. Will attach the SPDX scan output when done.

Samir Khandekar: Good. Owners: Mira -> Mosaic-X-1.2, Josh -> FalconLite-3B. Alex -> runtime perf support. Priya -> legal. Zoe -> product acceptance. I'll be Q/A lead for catalog metadata and perf profile definitions.

Josh Patel: quick question on perf tests: what's the canonical command and config?

Samir Khandekar: Use this perf script: ```bash
./tools/bench_infer.sh --model FalconLite-3B --batch-sizes 1 4 8 --seq-lens 128 512 --iters 200 --quant q5
``` capture p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec. Put outputs in `gs://redwood-model-bench/<model>/<date>/` and link here.

Alex Gomez: will run that tomorrow 9:30am PT. If we hit p95 > 300ms on T4, I'll try quant fallback and report.

Priya Rao: FYI — if any contributor license agreements are present for model training data, that may affect distribution. I'll flag in the SPDX doc.

Zoe Carter: Also mark whether model supports streaming and function/tool-calling (we prefer streaming APIs for chat). If not, document why.

Mira Chen: Mosaic-X: streaming works but needs patched tokenizer for a small edge case. I'll include patch PR link.

catalog-bot: New catalog entry draft created for Mosaic-X-1.2 by Mira Chen — https://console.redwood/models/drafts/Mosaic-X-1.2

Samir Khandekar: Great. Next steps checklist: 1) Legal signoff (Priya) 2) Perf profiles in gs://redwood-model-bench (Alex/Josh) 3) Metadata draft + tokenizer patch (Mira) 4) Product acceptance criteria (Zoe) 5) Catalog publish once all green. Owners, add ETA comments inline and I'll follow up in the daily sync if not done.

Josh Patel: ETA for perf results: tomorrow EOD PT.

Mira Chen: License + SPDX upload by tomorrow afternoon. Tokenizer PR in review.

Priya Rao: I'll post license clearance or open items by 48h.

Alex Gomez: Perf results posted by 10/03 18:00 UTC (will link).

Zoe Carter: I'll review product acceptance as soon as perf + legal are in.

Samir Khandekar: Thanks all — ping me with blockers. :raised_hands:
